definition_pinned: lambda_hat is |C0_measured| / C0_registered — the SURVIVING CONTRAST FRACTION at the pilot's depth (1,871 transpiled 2q gates), not a per-gate rate. The ledger row and finding label it 'attenuation rate per 2q gate'; a per-gate rate of 0.0259 would extinguish contrast in ~40 gates, contradicting the row's own ~475-gate ceiling. The per-gate rate the fraction implies is -ln(lambda_hat)/1871 = 0.001954, 1/e depth 512 gates; with lambda_hat +/- 1 se the 1/e depth spans 393-598 gates.
